title: Beyond the Last Stone
description: Read for a concrete way to distinguish what people know, claim, and choose.

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: Beyond the Last Stone makes careful thinking a matter of staying alive. Hungry people must compare observations, inherited stories, and reasons for acting together.
readerInvitation.readerPromise: Read for a concrete way to distinguish what people know, claim, and choose.
readerInvitation.audienceFit: This book suits readers who enjoy philosophical fiction with direct, spare language.
readerInvitation.closingInvitation: Begin with Fire After the Herd, then follow those questions into the city.
readerOutcomes: Read for a concrete way to distinguish what people know, claim, and choose.

contentSamples.readingValue: Reading their disagreements reveals why useful stories still require attention to their purpose.
It gives readers distinctions to test, rather than conclusions delivered by an outside lecturer.

reservedForReading: Later plot revelations, deaths, reversals and final resolutions
Exhaustive retelling and unsupported claims about real technology
